title: Telegram Desktop data folder
whyItMatters: Telegram Desktop keeps the signed-in account, cached chats, photos and files locally. The tdata folder is enough to open the account on another computer.
source: Telegram Desktop is open source and keeps its working folder (tdata) in the app-data folder: https://github.com/telegramdesktop/tdesktop
notes: Standard installed build. A portable build keeps tdata next to Telegram.exe, the Microsoft Store build uses Telegram Desktop UWP under %APPDATA%, and a custom working directory moves it. A local passcode encrypts the key data.
